api_version.description: Conmon API version to use (e.g., v1, v2).

bundle.description: Location of the OCI Bundle path for the container.

exec_mode.description: Whether to run in exec mode.

exec_attach.description: Attach to an exec session (used only if exec_mode=true).

exec_process_spec.description: Path to process spec for exec (used only if exec_mode=true).

exit_command.description: Path to program to execute on container termination.

exit_command_args.description: Additional arguments for exit_command; list of strings.

exit_dir.description: Directory where exit files are written.

stdin_open.description: Open stdin pipe regardless of terminal presence.

leave_stdin_open.description: Leave stdin open after client disconnects.

log_level.description: Log verbosity (e.g., debug, info, warn, error); empty = no debug logging.

log_path.description: Path to log file for container stdout/stderr.

log_size_max.description: Maximum log file size in bytes; -1 = unlimited.

log_tag.description: Additional tag to prepend to log lines.

new_keyring.description: Create a new session keyring for the container.

sync_log.description: Manually call sync on logs after shutdown.

container_pidfile.description: PID file for initial container process.

conmon_pidfile.description: PID file for the conmon process.

runtime.description: OCI runtime to use (e.g., runc, crun).

replace_listen_pid.description: Replace listen PID if set for oci-runtime pid.

restore_args.description: Runtime arguments passed to restore command; list of strings.

systemd_cgroup.description: Use systemd cgroup manager instead of cgroupfs.

sync_mode.description: Keep main conmon process as child (single fork only).

timeout.description: Container timeout in seconds; -1 = no timeout.

runtime_opts.description: Additional options passed to runtime; list of strings.
